channel.title: Yorben Vandersleyen — Engineering & Apps
channel.description: Engineering logs and release announcements for native Apple ecosystem applications: Cockpit, Tape, Needle, Rime, and Waybill.

item.title: Cockpit: Unified Daily Productivity HUD for macOS & Windows
item.description: Cockpit unifies your daily schedule, Notion workspaces, and real-time hardware telemetry into a single distraction-free popover and 24-hour day dial. Built natively with sub-millisecond responsiveness (<0.1% CPU idle overhead) for macOS and now Windows (x64 and ARM64). Free and open source under MIT.

item.title: Rime: Distraction-Free Frosted-Ice PDF Reader for macOS
item.description: Rime freezes out background screen clutter with a frosted glass focus backdrop, leaving only your document. Designed for deep reading, research, and papers with continuous vertical flow, multi-tab support, and instant keyboard bookmarks. 100% native Swift and PDFKit.

item.title: Needle: What's Playing, Beside the Dock
item.description: Introducing Needle, Tape's musical counterpart: the album cover in the empty corner beside the Dock, with track titles tinted in real-time by the artwork's dominant color palette. Works with Apple Music, Spotify, Podcasts, and browsers. Free on Homebrew.

item.title: Tape: A Native macOS Stock Ticker Beside the Dock
item.description: Introducing Tape: A native macOS stock and crypto ticker sitting in the empty corner beside the Dock. Displays one asset at a time with brand-matched colors, fluid AppKit & Core Animation transitions, and Homebrew support.

item.title: Building Cockpit: A Zero-Cloud macOS & iPad Productivity HUD
item.description: Technical deep dive into building Cockpit: A modular heads-up display engineered for macOS and iPadOS consolidating Calendar, Music, Notion, and Mail into a zero-cloud physical control surface with peer-to-peer Network.framework encryption.

item.title: Simulating 3D Logistics Dioramas on iPadOS with RealityKit & SwiftUI
item.description: Behind the scenes of Waybill: tactile 3D logistics idle dioramas on iPadOS powered by Apple's RealityKit engine, custom physics, procedural routing, and mathematical balance modeling.
